ios.rationale: Bounded release/client source inspection finds a terminal app and embedded browser client, with no native phone application. Phone browser access remains separate.

android.rationale: Bounded release/client source inspection finds a terminal app and embedded browser client, with no native phone application. Phone browser access remains separate.

codex.rationale: Documented session integration; managed resume limitations retained.

gemini-cli.rationale: Docs index at v1.22.3 lists Gemini CLI as a supported, auto-detected agent; structured-view docs note it is deprecated upstream for individual accounts.

cursor.rationale: Docs index at v1.22.3 lists Cursor CLI as a supported, auto-detected agent; it runs in the terminal view.

antigravity.rationale: Agent of Empires v1.22.3 registers Antigravity with the agy executable, install command, permission flag and status detector. Antigravity terminal launch is supported; the released session-resume table does not verify resume or fork for this agent.

aider.rationale: The structured-view documentation names aider among tools that run in terminal view, so aider runs as a named tool in a tmux session without an ACP adapter, status detection or verified resume.

local.rationale: Installed agents run on AoE host.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The scoped runtime and endpoint implementation uses operator-controlled machines; no ADE-vendor execution service exists.

worktree.rationale: Git working-copy separation. Re-attested 2026-11-08 after an independent cross-check correction to agent-of-empires:RUN-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

container.rationale: Docker/Podman/Apple Container options. Re-attested 2026-11-08 after an independent cross-check correction to agent-of-empires:RUN-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

vm.rationale: AoE explicitly offers apple_container. Its pinned source invokes the Apple container CLI, and Apple first-party technical docs establish a lightweight VM per container. Scope is that optional Apple-silicon macOS backend, not Docker/Podman or a user-hosted VM.

license.rationale: MIT main app, disclosed Apache derived file.

laptop-independent.rationale: SSH/tunnel host keeps sessions after client disconnect.

free-plan.rationale: The first-party offering is the free open-source application with no paid ADE tier in the checked offering. Agent/model subscriptions and user-owned compute are separate. Free-plan requires a paid tier alongside the free offering.

subscription.rationale: The first-party offering is the free open-source application with no paid ADE tier in the checked offering. Agent/model subscriptions and user-owned compute are separate. Free-plan requires a paid tier alongside the free offering.

per-seat.rationale: The first-party offering is the free open-source application with no paid ADE tier in the checked offering. Agent/model subscriptions and user-owned compute are separate. Free-plan requires a paid tier alongside the free offering.

usage-based.rationale: The first-party offering is the free open-source application with no paid ADE tier in the checked offering. Agent/model subscriptions and user-owned compute are separate. Free-plan requires a paid tier alongside the free offering.

compute.rationale: The first-party offering is the free open-source application with no paid ADE tier in the checked offering. Agent/model subscriptions and user-owned compute are separate. Free-plan requires a paid tier alongside the free offering.

one-time.rationale: The first-party offering is the free open-source application with no paid ADE tier in the checked offering. Agent/model subscriptions and user-owned compute are separate. Free-plan requires a paid tier alongside the free offering.

byok.rationale: The official structured-view guide explicitly supports user-supplied provider API keys and documents passing them from aoe serve into managed agents. This is BYOK provider billing, separate from the free ADE application fee.

byo-subscription.rationale: Docs at v1.22.3: Claude authenticates through claude auth login and Codex through codex login, the agents' native sign-ins. Managed Codex resume/fork needs an API key. Not tested.

free-tier.rationale: Free MIT download through Homebrew or install script; homepage shows no price.

starting-price.rationale: No paid plan on the homepage or README; the application is free to install. Agent costs excluded.

macos.rationale: The complete supported-platform documentation lists native Linux/macOS CLI/TUI support and explicitly restricts Windows to WSL2. This scope is a terminal client, not a GUI app.

linux.rationale: The complete supported-platform documentation lists native Linux/macOS CLI/TUI support and explicitly restricts Windows to WSL2. This scope is a terminal client, not a GUI app.

windows.rationale: The complete supported-platform documentation lists native Linux/macOS CLI/TUI support and explicitly restricts Windows to WSL2. This scope is a terminal client, not a GUI app.

issue-tracking.rationale: The first-party Board contract explicitly makes every card a session; inspection of core storage and plugin state confirms no independent issue/task entity.

unattended-triggers.rationale: The official optional cron plugin creates a session and sends its first prompt at scheduled times without a human starting each run; host and plugin must stay running.

roles.rationale: The optional first-party CityHall server provides named human roles and permission keys. Standalone AoE token/passphrase access does not provide those roles.

sso.rationale: The optional first-party CityHall server supports OpenID Connect SSO; this does not claim SSO inside the standalone AoE daemon.

coordinator.rationale: Bounded inspection finds session-control tools in the inbound MCP server (list_sessions, create_session with parent_session_id, send, read_output) that a user-connected agent can call, but the product ships no coordinator role, recipe or designated coordinator session; user-assembled orchestration does not count.

pr-workflow.rationale: The inspected core CLI/server/worktree implementation has no built-in PR workflow; external tracker links and developer gh instructions do not establish one.

multiplayer.rationale: ADR 0002 states one daemon serves one human with no session owner or human audit log; multi-user control is delegated to separate CityHall deployments of one daemon per user, and live control belongs to one window.

paid-from.rationale: The product website states free and open source under MIT, /pricing returns 404, the website source has no pricing page and the MIT licence has no paid tier; separate agent costs are not ADE plans.
